description.value: Starting at 17th level, a geomancer benefits from Blindsight out to 30 feet while in any favored terrain she has chosen. This ability makes invisibility and concealment (even magical darkness) irrelevant to the geomancer, though she still can't see ethereal creatures and must have line of effect to discern a creature or object. Blindsight never allows distinguishing color or visual contrast, doesn't allow reading, doesn't subject her to gaze attacks, isn't penalized by blinding attacks, is thwarted by deafening attacks, works underwater but not in a vacuum, and negates displacement and blur effects.
